info.title: QuorumKV M11 CAS and replicated sessions
info.description: Application profile v2 only: config_version=2, application_version=2, IDENTITY v2, empty-origin bootstrap; no automatic v1 migration. Mutation identity=(client_id,sequence), not generated request_id. Latest result/original index retained per client, 1024 sessions without TTL/eviction. Every retry still requires a new leader/quorum/apply attempt. No exactly-once delivery, automatic client retry, snapshots or rolling negotiation. GET contract unchanged. M12 adds read-only local diagnostics. Metrics never establish quorum or authorize client completion.
